candidates.snippet: ### Motivation.  The Rust frontend is planned to become the default for `vllm serve` (#68784). One item there is to make sure front-end CI coverage runs with both front-ends. candidates.title: [Bug]: HF3FS connector reports a failed load as finished and never returns the failed block IDs
candidates.snippet: ## Summary  When the HF3FS KV connector's load fails (a missing key, a raised metadata lookup, or a short read), the connector reports the request as finished receiving but never returns the failed block IDs.
